comparison: Geometry vs transferred HBGD vs combined
result: Simple distribution-normalized HBGD transfer did not outperform the target geometry baseline on the untouched test cohort.
scientific_interpretation: Simple normalization of source growth distributions was insufficient to establish predictive transfer.
key_limitation: Source HBGD phenotype sample was small.

comparison: Source cancer vs LUMIERE GBM phenotype structure
result: Descriptive comparison showed comparable structure across several HBGD-derived temporal features.
scientific_interpretation: The analysis suggested that HBGD-derived growth phenotypes have potentially transferable structure.
key_limitation: The reported phenotype distance was descriptive and was not sufficient to establish statistical alignment.

comparison: Observed phenotype distance vs permutation distribution
result: Observed standardized phenotype distance = 2.659276; permutation p-value = 1.000000.
scientific_interpretation: Simple phenotype-distance alignment was not statistically supported.
key_limitation: Only 25 source phenotype subjects and 67 target subjects.

comparison: Source transfer vs domain-adapted transfer vs geometry
result: Domain adaptation improved unadapted HBGD transfer but remained worse than the target geometry-only model.
scientific_interpretation: Target-domain adaptation can reduce transfer mismatch, but the tested adaptation strategy did not establish superiority over geometry.
key_limitation: Simple residual correction and small source cohort.

result: Geometry + HBGD rate showed approximately 0.97% improvement over geometry in the held-out test comparison; all-HBGD features showed approximately 0.63% improvement.
scientific_interpretation: HBGD-derived information appears to contribute a small incremental signal beyond geometry.
key_limitation: Magnitude was modest and not statistically validated at this stage.

result: Test MAE improved from 7.4912 mm to 7.1862 mm; 8/13 patients improved; mean patient-level improvement was 0.7685 mm.
scientific_interpretation: The HBGD-rate representation showed a directional patient-level benefit beyond geometry.
key_limitation: Bootstrap CI crossed zero and paired permutation p = 0.274745; n = 13 patients.

result: HBGD-rate MAE improved within Growth, Stable and Shrinkage phenotypes.
scientific_interpretation: The incremental HBGD signal was observed across all three evaluated phenotypes.
key_limitation: The analysis was based on the small 13-patient test cohort and did not by itself establish statistical significance.

result: Stable phenotype showed the strongest patient-level effect; Growth and Shrinkage effects were smaller.
scientific_interpretation: HBGD benefit may vary according to growth phenotype, with stable lesions showing a potentially stronger incremental signal.
key_limitation: Stable phenotype permutation p = 0.086191; other phenotypes were not significant.

result: No strong explanatory factor was identified. Longer intervals showed a positive descriptive association, while rate variability and absolute rate showed negative descriptive associations.
scientific_interpretation: The analysis provides candidate mechanisms but does not establish causality or statistically significant relationships.
key_limitation: Only 32 patient-phenotype observations were available for correlation analysis.

comparison: GBM geometry vs Geometry + Transferred HBGD
result: Geometry test MAE = 7.4565 mm; Geometry + Transferred HBGD test MAE = 7.3678 mm; improvement = 1.19%.
scientific_interpretation: A source-derived HBGD representation provided a small incremental improvement beyond target-domain geometry on the untouched test cohort.
key_limitation: The direct transferred representation alone was worse than geometry; improvement was modest.

result: 9/13 patients improved; mean improvement = 0.2062 mm; median = 0.1613 mm; effect size = 0.5062; bootstrap 95% CI = [-0.0083, 0.4210]; permutation p = 0.097390; Wilcoxon p = 0.146484.
scientific_interpretation: The transferred HBGD representation showed a consistent directional benefit with a moderate paired effect size, but statistical significance was not established.
key_limitation: Only 13 held-out patients; bootstrap CI crossed zero and both paired tests had p > 0.05.
